findings.problem: AC 'an Edit touching a line between two cases is still denied' has no case: PW4 edits a line above the first case, which no case bound can reach (passes at base and under any header overrun).
findings.scenario: case_header_end overruns by a few lines; a column-0 helper between the wrapped B1 and B2 becomes editable under B1's unfreeze; every PW case stays green.
findings.closure: Closure: PW4's edited line sits at column 0 between the wrapped B1 body and the next case, denied under B1's unfreeze, and the case is red when case_header_end returns a later line.

findings.problem: worktree_kit_check denies every worktree add under .claude/worktrees/ on an ignored-.claude project, including /loop:review's bugfix base checkout (no -b), which needs no kit; at base it asked.
findings.scenario: UI bugfix pass in moi on an EcoCrew-shaped project: `git worktree add .claude/worktrees/<slug>-base <base>` is hard-denied, review stops.
findings.closure: Closure: the deny covers only the track-fork shape (`-b`/`-B` branch creation); a git-guard case on setup lpwtignored with `git worktree add .claude/worktrees/x-base main` expects ask, seen red first; G22.115 stays deny.

findings.problem: The `.claude/hooks/probe` check-ignore test reads every ignore source and never asks whether the kit is tracked: a project that commits .claude/ but has a .claude/ rule in core.excludesFile, info/exclude or a leftover .gitignore line gets forks refused (hook, doctor, tracks, orchestrate) though worktrees would carry the kit.
findings.scenario: Team repo commits .claude/; a developer's global ignore holds .claude/; worktree add is denied with no approval, /kit:doctor reports DIVERGENCE.
findings.closure: Closure: hook, doctor, tracks and orchestrate refuse only when the probe is ignored AND HEAD tracks no file under .claude/hooks (`git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- .claude/hooks` empty); a git-guard case with tracked .claude/hooks plus an ignore rule keeps today's verdict and a doctor case reports ok, both seen red first.

findings.problem: No case covers a session in a record-less tree pushing `-C` into the tree that holds the record (critic Q2 direction).
findings.scenario: Mutation: record read from the -C tree with the toplevel equality dropped; a main-tree session pushes the feat worktree's branch without ask; suite green.
findings.closure: Closure: {"id":"G22.111.2","verdict":"ask","setup":"lp","cwd":"__MAIN_TREE__","command":"git -C __FEAT_TREE__ push -u origin feat/s1","reason":"pushes to a remote"} passes.

findings.problem: The pr-assets allow has no negative for the shared barriers (HEAD off the record branch, released record, tag pr-assets, push-config refusal).
findings.scenario: A refactor exempts assets from the HEAD/released/tag/config checks; `git push origin refs/heads/pr-assets` is allowed with HEAD elsewhere or a redirected pushurl; suite green.
findings.closure: Closure: ask cases for pr-assets + HEAD on another branch, + released record, + tag pr-assets, + one lpcfg* push config, each passing.

findings.problem: Reproduction cases G22.101/G22.104/G22.109 run with cwd = tree root, while EcoCrew ran from frontend/; mutations `cdir == BASE_DIR` or `root = realpath(base)` stay green.
findings.scenario: Either mutation ships; the EcoCrew agent in frontend/ still gets the ask this pass removes; suite green.
findings.closure: Closure: G22.101, G22.104 and G22.109 (or .2 siblings) run with "cwd":"__FEAT_TREE__/docs/work" and pass.

findings.problem: Unterminated or misscanned header (backslash-newline string, nested same-quote f-string, a dropped `:`) runs the case to EOF and swallows later cases in rows mode (refuted as Major under the careless-agent model).
findings.scenario: A broken unfrozen header lets edits to later frozen cases through until it is fixed.
findings.closure: Closure: case_header_end returns start (the old one-line bound) when no depth-0 `:` is found, with a PW case on a dropped-colon header.

findings.problem: check_worktree_kit decides on `check-ignore -v`, which exits 0 on a negation match: `.claude/*` + `!.claude/hooks/` reported as divergence; also duplicates ignored-loop-paths on a .claude/ ignore.
findings.scenario: A project re-including .claude/hooks gets a false DIVERGENCE.
findings.closure: Closure: decide with -q, use -v only to name the line.

findings.problem: github.md says `git -C <root>` without 'absolute' (record_allow accepts only /abs), and calls `cd <root> && …` before git unplaceable, now stale for read-only git and fetch.
findings.scenario: An agent in frontend/ writes `git -C .. push -u origin feat/x` and gets an ask / blocked stop.
findings.closure: Closure: github.md says `git -C <absolute root>` and drops the stale cd sentence.

findings.problem: Test-plan gaps: PW9.3 cannot fail for F8, PW5 appends after a single-line case, no single-line decorated case, PW3/PW8.2 no needle, G22.115 needle not the line, G22.112 cwd, no closed-list fetch option case, N4 one direction, AM68 released / project-dir fallback / python ask in auto, contract needles file-wide.
findings.scenario: Narrow regressions in those paths stay green.
findings.closure: Closure: the listed cases tightened or added.

findings.problem: root_fetch ignores global -c options / GIT_* env assigns and checks remote paths against the session cwd, not the cd target.
findings.scenario: `cd <root> && git fetch vendorrepo main` from frontend/ fetches a local repo path without ask.
findings.closure: Closure: root_fetch requires no configs, git_env or other globals.

findings.problem: The degraded-config exit ask (__cwk_exit) bypasses ask() and still reaches the user in auto.
findings.scenario: Unreadable project.json in an auto pass: the git hook asks.
findings.closure: Closure: the degraded-config exit of enforce-git-workflow.sh is a blocked stop in auto.

findings.problem: /loop:small has no up-front probe: on an ignored-.claude project the hook deny fires after the user's go, and its text ('run this story in the main tree') contradicts small.md.
findings.scenario: Wasted dispatch go, confusing deny text.
findings.closure: Closure: small-dispatch-check.sh refuses before the go; the deny text points to /loop:spec for small-* paths.

findings.problem: The docs check sits after the merge; handoff wording names a `Next:` line the template lacks; review_status enum does not hold a round/verdict; worktree_kit_check misses `git -C x worktree add` and aliases, matches `echo git worktree add …`; install warning misses `.claude/*`.
findings.closure: Closure: wording aligned and regex widened in a later pass.

findings.problem: The case-boundary walk is written twice (hook and lib); record_allow threads an assets flag through shared checks (C2, refuted as Major).
findings.scenario: The two walks drift apart again.
findings.closure: Closure: one shared boundary walk; assets verdict in its own function.
